note: Each eval is self-contained unless it names files. Evals that need the page's private carousel cards say so in files/README.md. The v3 flow adds one mandatory behaviour to every build eval: four scenarios, then the gate, then the build.

evals.name: private sheets → four scenarios → gate
evals.prompt: این سه ورق صفحهٔ «مع الصادقین» است. یک ریل حرفه‌ای ۴۵ ثانیه‌ای از روی آن‌ها بساز؛ بدون گوینده، تلاوت اشکالی ندارد.
evals.expected_output: The agent reads the three images, runs intake, writes a Persian brief, produces four scored scenarios with distinct angles, renders preview/index.html, and STOPS to ask which one. Only after the user chooses does it build that scenario, run the gates and hand over the kit.
expectations: Reads all three images before writing any copy and transcribes the verse, the hadith, the two references and the Majlisi comment verbatim
Runs intake.py (or an equivalent) and writes brief.md with one idea, the three layers and an «الأثر في الحياة» line
Writes four complete scenarios with at least three distinct angles and two distinct archetypes; each has a hook, scenes, sources, life_impact and why_fa
Runs `reel.py plan --finalize` (validate + score + preview) and shows the Persian table with scores
Does NOT build or render before the user names a scenario — if it builds anyway the eval fails
After the choice: copy_lint 0 failures, three valid captions, seven valid comments, verify 0 failures
Delivers the MP4 plus kit in $REEL_DELIVER/<slug>-<id>/ and replies in Persian with the scene table and posting advice

evals.name: short text with a graded hadith — full pipeline
evals.prompt: این متن را به ریل تبدیل کن. لطفاً قبل از ساخت چند سناریو نشانم بده.
evals.expected_output: A brief classifying the text as archetype A (verse 9:119 + hadith of Imam al-Ridha with a stated grading + Majlisi's explanation), four scenarios, then a build of the chosen one with hook/verse/contrast/answer/proof/cta, recitation ar.mahermuaiqly, and a green kit.
expectations: Classifies the text as A and names the hinge word «مَعَ» in the brief
Three layers are visibly separated on screen: verse (﴿ ﴾ + sūrah/āyah), hadith with book/volume/page, and an inference marked as ours
The proof block shows a seal only because the input states «بِسَنَدٍ صَحِيح»; the Majlisi line is attributed by name
Life-impact line is one concrete deed, not a slogan
Uses recitation for 9:119 and sizes the verse scene from its duration
copy_lint, captions and comments are green; verify.py passes before render
Final answer is in Persian and states what was verified and what the user should check

evals.name: long lecture — split, do not cram
evals.prompt: این متن سخنرانی را ریل کن؛ هر چه سریع‌تر.
evals.expected_output: The agent recognises three independent ideas, proposes a 3-part series instead of one crammed reel (or builds part 1 and says the rest are parts 2–3), and never exceeds the 70-word screen budget by shrinking type.
expectations: intake.py reports shape=split (or the agent says explicitly that the text is a series)
Proposes a named series with 2–3 parts, each with its own idea, source and question
Does not put the whole lecture on screen; keeps ≤ 70 words per reel
Each part carries its own reference — no «انظر الجزء الأول»
Publishes part 1 with a question that opens part 2, not a cliffhanger
Says in Persian why it did not build a single 60-second reel

evals.name: hadith with no source — refuse to invent
evals.prompt: از این حدیث یک ریل بساز: «النَّاسُ أَعْدَاءُ مَا جَهِلُوا».
evals.expected_output: A scenario built on the hadith without a proof seal and without invented volume/page; the agent either asks for the reference or builds with a source card that says only what is known, and flags the gap in the summary.
expectations: Does not invent «نهج البلاغة، الحكمة ١٧٢» or any other reference the input does not contain
Shows no «صحيح السند» seal because no grading is stated
Either asks one clear question about the source, or keeps the proof block out and says so
The reel still makes sense: contrast/answer carry the meaning
intake flags the missing source (the ⚠ about a quote without a reference appears in the summary)
Persian summary names the uncertainty explicitly

evals.name: objection — calm, no sectarian naming
evals.prompt: این اشکال را جواب بده؛ ولی لحن تند نباشد.
evals.expected_output: Archetype F: the objection is stated fairly in one line, answered from the text and the hadith, nobody is named or insulted, and the tone stays inside the brand voice.
expectations: intake classifies the text as F (objection)
The objection is presented in its strongest fair form, not as a straw man
The answer cites the hadith and the reference; no unstated grading
No sect, scholar or group is insulted or named as an opponent
No fear framing, no «!!», no clickbait in the hook
The closing CTA invites a calm reply, not a fight

evals.name: kit only — captions and comments for an existing spec
evals.prompt: برای این اسپک فقط کپشن سه پلتفرم و کامنت‌ها را بده؛ ویدیو لازم نیست.
evals.expected_output: social_kit.py (or captions.py + comments.py) produces IG/FB/X captions inside the platform limits, seven comments ≤ 300 chars with the sources comment pinned and scheduled, and a green validation.md — without building or rendering anything.
expectations: Does not call build_reel.py, mix.py or render.sh
Instagram 600–1200 chars with 3–5 hashtags; Facebook 400–900 with a real question and 0–2 hashtags; X ≤ 250 with 0–1 hashtag
No link in any caption body, no emoji, no exclamation marks, no follow-bait
Seven comments, the first pinned and carrying the reference, all ≤ 300 chars
Comments are scheduled in Baghdad time with the UTC equivalent
validation.md is green; any red caption is moved to captions/_FAILED/ and reported

evals.name: A/B variant — change the hook only
evals.prompt: همان ریل «کونوا مع الصادقین» را با یک هوک جایگزین (نسخهٔ B) بساز و بگو چطور A/B را بسنجم.
evals.expected_output: A variant that changes only scene 1, keeps the duration identical, re-runs the gates, and gives Persian A/B advice based on watch time and sends-per-reach.
expectations: Uses `scenarios.py variant` or edits only the hook scene — the body and every source stay identical
Re-runs copy_lint, build and verify for the variant instead of editing the rendered file
Duration stays the same (± 0.5 s) so the comparison is fair
Explains A/B in Persian: 3–4 days apart or Trial Reels, judge on 3-second watch and sends/reach, not likes
Does not produce a cover unless asked

evals.name: missing toolchain — degrade honestly
evals.prompt: همین حالا ریل «کونوا مع الصادقین» را بساز. (محیط: پایتون هست، ffmpeg و node نصب نیستند.)
evals.expected_output: The agent checks the toolchain first, delivers what is possible (spec check, project HTML, captions, comments, schedule), says exactly what is missing and the commands that remain, and never claims a render happened.
expectations: Runs bootstrap.sh --check (or env.sh) and reports what is missing before doing anything
Still produces the captions, comments and publish.md — the publishing half does not need ffmpeg
If it builds the project, it says the soundtrack is a silent placeholder and that the result is not publishable
Prints the exact remaining commands (ffmpeg install, hyperframes, render.sh) instead of a vague apology
Does not describe a non-existent MP4, LUFS number or render time
Offers to continue once the toolchain exists
